article.headline: Blums scores 23 as Davidson takes down Richmond 79-54
article.description: — Roberts Blums' 23 points off of the bench helped lead Davidson to a 79-54 victory over Richmond on Saturday.
article.linkText: Blums scores 23 as Davidson takes down Richmond 79-54
article.story: RICHMOND, Va. -- — Roberts Blums' 23 points off of the bench helped lead Davidson to a 79-54 victory over Richmond on Saturday. Blums also added six rebounds for the Wildcats (13-8, 5-4 Atlantic 10 Conference). Parker Friedrichsen scored 15 points and added three steals. Josh Scovens shot 7 of 10 from the field to finish with 14 points. Will Johnston led the way for the Spiders (13-10, 3-7) with 11 points. Richmond also got 10 points from Aiden Argabright. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
